findings.title: POST /api/collab/trips Missing Ownership Check Enables Full Trip Takeover & Data Exfiltration
findings.details: ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE overwrites title, access_mode, and data_json without checking owner_id; then INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_members inserts attacker as owner. Attacker can read existing comments/expenses, restore version 1 to read original private itinerary, and remove original owner from trip_members.

findings.title: Public Trip GET Leaks Member Emails & Private Expenses/Comments/Votes; Non-Members Can Comment/Vote Across Trips
findings.details: Unauthenticated GET on public trips returns users.email, expenses, comments, polls, and poll_votes. Additionally, any signed-in non-member gets role=viewer on public trips and can POST comments/votes (comments/vote only check `if (!user)`), and poll_votes does not verify poll_id belongs to tripId.

findings.title: PUT /api/collab/trips/:id Missing Optimistic Concurrency Check Causes Lost Updates
findings.details: PUT /api/collab/trips/:id ignores client version and runs UPDATE trips SET ... WHERE id = ? without AND version = ?, allowing stale concurrent writes to silently overwrite newer edits.

findings.title: POST /api/collab/join/:token Overwrites Existing Owner Role via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
findings.details: ON CONFLICT(trip_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role=excluded.role overwrites owner to viewer/editor. Because getMemberRole() checks trip_members before trips.owner_id, the owner loses owner and editor permissions on their own trip.

findings.title: worker/collab.js Missing verifyCsrf(request) Check & Permissive Wildcard CORS on /api/profile & OPTIONS
findings.details: handleCollabRequest never calls verifyCsrf(request), accepting state-changing requests with cross-origin Origin headers (relying solely on SameSite=Lax, which fails on same-site subdomains). Meanwhile /api/profile returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and permits X-Sync-Key cross-origin.

findings.title: Auth Flaws: Password Reset Retains Sessions, OAuth Pre-Takeover & Unverified Email, Rate-Limit Bypass, Incomplete Account Deletion, SVG Avatar
findings.details: Verified: (1) reset-password does not delete existing rows in sessions; (2) request-reset never calls checkAuthRateLimit(ip, true); (3) Google OAuth ignores verified_email=false, sets kairos_oauth_state without Secure, and silently merges into an unverified password account without clearing password_hash/sessions; (4) logging into attacker own account calls clearAuthFailures(ip), resetting brute-force counter for all emails on that IP; (5) DELETE /api/account only deletes sessions and users, leaving trips/comments/expenses orphaned if PRAGMA foreign_keys is off (and trip_versions.author_id / expenses.payer_id lack FKs even when ON); (6) avatarUrl accepts data:image/svg+xml.

findings.title: Logout Leaves Local IndexedDB & Settings Intact, Causing Cross-User Data Leakage & Migration Into Next Logged-In Account

request.flow: Alice saves local data -> logout({ wipeAccountLocal: false }) -> Bob logs in -> Bob runs migrateLocalArchive()

findings.details: account-center.js calls AuthService.logout({ wipeAccountLocal: false }). IndexedDB stores (trips, travelStatus, expenses, userPhotos) and localStorage/settings (cloudSyncPassphrase, mapillaryToken, wtg_collab_spaces_v1) remain readable to the next user on the same browser and get imported into User B cloud account.

findings.title: CSV Formula Injection Across All 3 CSV Exporters & Unescaped startTime XSS in Printable HTML Export
findings.details: csvCell(), tripToCsv(), and settlementsToCsv() do not neutralize leading =, +, -, @, tab, or CR characters, enabling spreadsheet formula injection. Additionally, toPrintableHtml() interpolates s.startTime without escXml(), and exportTrip("pdf") passes the result to window.open().document.write(html) (same-origin DOM XSS) or downloads an HTML file.

findings.title: Worker Proxy, R2 Upload, Sync Key & CSP Weaknesses (/api/img SVG, /api/photos Unauth+Traversal, /api/profile Conflict Bypass, Weak CSP)
findings.details: Verified: (1) /api/img serves image/svg+xml on worker origin without CSP sandbox or nosniff; (2) /api/commons,/api/wikidata,/api/wikipedia proxy upstream Content-Type verbatim (e.g., text/html for format=jsonfm); (3) /api/photos allows unauthenticated uploads to R2 with no size/magic-byte validation and path traversal in X-Sync-Key; (4) /api/profile accepts low-entropy 16-char X-Sync-Key, bypasses optimistic lock when X-Base-Updated-At is omitted, and leaves profile_backups intact after DELETE; (5) HTML CSP is only `frame-ancestors *` on / (no script-src/object-src/base-uri; account modal can be opened inside an iframe on /).
